verdicts.reason: A reads left to right as a banner should (logo, product, copy, CTA) and keeps the product as the hero. Its flaws: the headline is small next to the oversized case, there is a loose gap between the headline and the 'Obsidian Buds, $179' line, and the logo is tiny and floats alone at the far left. B shrinks the hero product to a small thumbnail jammed at the left edge and floats the logo at top centre away from everything. It also leaves the bottom third of the canvas empty while the headline, subline and CTA sit on mismatched heights, so the layout looks scattered and top-heavy.
